subject: PR #758 opened for the auto-merge switch — approved, one conjunct is a denylist
body:
decision-path-classifier-gap moved after #719 merged and the new commit had no PR, so the steward cycle opened #758 as a draft and reviewed it. Full review: https://github.com/DanFashauer/SignalGrid-Review-Hub/pull/758#issuecomment-5670364157

THIS IS THE STRONGEST DIFF IN THE QUEUE and I want to be clear about that before the finding. The affirmative-green rule is right; preflight exit 0 being necessary but NOT sufficient, with every step required to report status ok, closes the exact false-green the header names. DECISION_PATH is refused twice over and the tier comes from classifyDiff over the real head diff rather than a cached claim, which is the direct answer to what #719 got wrong. pathForms closes a real hole: a/scripts/x.mjs could previously hide from the manifest. Self-test 28/28. And I checked the cross-file promise rather than assuming it: mutation-guard now says a merge authorizer must treat hung as inconclusive, and check-pr-gate-falsification:27 states the inversion and implements it. That is normally where this kind of thing rots; it did not.

THE BLOCKER, measured against the shipped function. Two panel fields follow the file's own rule (expectedLensesRan !== true, unanimous !== true). The other three do not:

  if (p.confirmedCritical) ...
  if (p.failOpen) ...
  if (p.vetoBlock) ...

Those are truthiness checks, so ABSENT PASSES. I ran it:

  panel missing confirmedCritical/failOpen/vetoBlock -> merge=true

A panel reporting only unanimous and expectedLensesRan authorizes an unattended merge with three of its five guards never answered. That is exactly the denylist the header forbids — "anything unknown or ABSENT means NO MERGE" — applied to the lens findings rather than the lens run. Live shapes that land there: a producer omitting falsy keys, a renamed field, a panel that failed before populating findings.

It bites safely from the other side too: confirmedCritical as the string "none" blocks, because any non-empty string is truthy. Safe, but it shows the three are read as booleans while nothing requires them to be one.

FIX, in the file's existing style: require === false for the three, exactly as the other two require === true, and treat a non-boolean as absent. Four lines and three self-test cases alongside the twenty-eight already there. I did not push it — this is safety machinery and the fix touches the authorizer's own semantics, so it is yours.

SEPARATELY, #753 at 1b49c46a: item (d)'s logic is sound (the conjunction means a seated credential vetoes radio absence). But the registration debt is now five rows and a 17->19 figure across three commits. I posted the full five-step checklist for adding a signal domain rather than listing the same items a fourth time.
